d: Nitish-Lalan Singh Meeting : bihar ki rajniti men nitish kumar aur kendriy mantri lalan sinh ki mulakat ne ek bar phir siyasi charchaon ko tej kar diya hai... band kamre men huee is mulakat ke bad saval uth rahe hain ki kya janta dal yunaited men koee bara rajnitik badlav hone vala hai? kya nishant kumar ko parti men bari jimmedari mil sakti hai? kya unhen dipti siem banae jane ki charcha men koee dam hai? JDU ke bhitar chal rahi gatividhiyon aur BJP ke sath gathbandhan ke samikran par is mulakat ka kya asar par sakta hai?
